rationale: The discourse has stabilized into a well-defined but unresolved impasse: all sides accept the need for restructuring, yet the core dispute over closures, compulsory redundancies, and the evidentiary threshold remains substantively unresolved. The last two rounds mostly repeat hardened positions while deferring resolution to an audit, so further open-ended bargaining is unlikely to change anything without a structured intervention around the audit mandate and decision rules.
